snippet.title: Little Crossroads - Cozy Multiplayer Game just launched its Steam Store Page 🚀 Wishlist Now! 🥰
snippet.description:
🌸 Welcome to Little Crossroads! A cozy multiplayer game where you can fish, chop wood, mine ore, and explore a peaceful world with friends.
Wishlist Now 🥰 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3627770/Little_Crossroads/?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=initial 

Little Crossroads is created with love by Term & Zera, a pair of married Game Devs chasing their dreams of creating games for the whole world to enjoy, featuring their dog Freya 🐶

💬 What do you think of the trailer? Let us know in the comments!

🎥 Check out our full playlist of Little Crossroads Content:
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLl1kYzfJzQ7eM00Nwcdq6wXzMugDTYxVh

🏡 Join our community on Discord: https://discord.gg/yS2WehDZpS

🎶 Music Credits: @Haakond 

#cozygames #indiegame #multiplayer #animalcrossing #stardewvalley
